projects.note: One item of PVC Cards and Adhesive Plastic will give 100 uses. One use is spent per step attempt, even on failure.
One item of Cardstock and Adhesive Plastic will give 100 uses. One use is spent per step attempt.
One item of Cardstock will give 100 uses. One use is spent per step attempt.

One item of Bond paper will give 100 uses, one Spraycan will recharge 100%. One use for Bond Paper, 5% for White Spraypaint and 2% for Black Spraypaint are spent per step attempt. Stencil cutting is a risky step and is more likely to fail.
One item of Bond Paper will give 100 uses, one Inkwell will recharge 100%. One use and 1% are spent per step attempt. Sealing is a risky step and is more likely to fail.
One item of Bond Paper will give 100 uses, one Inkwell and Glue will recharge 100%. One use for Bond Paper, 1% for Inkwell and 20% for Glue are spent per step attempt.
Brass Ingots are used instantly, one key per ingot. Step #3 - Filing - is risky and more likely to fail.
Bond Paper and Inkwells work as usual. Medical bills are used instantly, one prescription per bill.
Bond Paper and Adhesive Plastic work as usual. Glow sticks are used instantly, one visa per stick. Step #3 - Embossing - is risky and more likely to fail.
Bond Paper and Inkwells work as usual. Bank Statements are used instantly, one check per statement. Step #3 - Embossing - is dangerous and very likely to fail.
Step #4 - Graving - is dangerous and very likely to fail, while step #6 - Enamel Grinding - is risky and likely to fail.

Bonded Latex is the only restricting component, everything else is fairly common and easy to acquire. Tools are also a concern, namely the Hot Foil Stamper obtainable only as a unique outcome from the Printing Works burglary target.
Steps #3 and #4 - Embossing and Stamping - are dangerous and very likely to fail, the former likely to crit while the latter likely to have soft fails. I advice you do them shortly after a crit to limit CS loss in case of failure.

materialsNote:
The items present here are all confirmed to be used as of December 19th 2024.
Drop rates and sources are based on other data gathered, 358k logs for burglary and 125k logs for pickpocketing, therefore it's fairly accurate.

Some of the high skill items produced through this crime are likely to be used for future crimes. Bank statements, medical bills, brass ingots and aluminum plates may be more necessary than initially though if this is the case.

Recommended amount of items and where they're used is speculation based on CS gain and expected amount of projects per bracket. The exact amounts may not be entirely accurate, but should be good enough for most players.
projectsNote:
Some items will add 100 uses per unit spent, namely: Blank PVC Cards, Cardstock, Bond Paper and Adhesive Plastic. Some items will add/top up a percentage of uses, namely: Printer Toner, Spraycans, Glue and Inkwells.
These items are tracked for the whole crime, this applies to both uses remaining and percentages remaining. Adding Bond Paper to a Diploma project will let surplus units to be used by Birth Certificate projects and so on.

⚠ Steps marked with this symbol are risky - There's an increased chance of failing.
☠ Steps marked with this symbol are dangerous - It is unknown how this affects the step.
